FieldErrors.invalidEmail: Enter a valid email address, like name@example.com.
FieldErrors.passwordTooShort: Use at least 12 characters. A few unrelated words make a strong, memorable password.
FieldErrors.passwordTooLong: This password is too long. Please use a shorter one.
FieldErrors.passwordTooWeak: This password is too easy to guess. Please choose another.

Fields.passwordHint: At least 12 characters. No special rules: a long passphrase works best.

SignIn.title: Sign in
SignIn.description: Welcome back. Sign in to continue.
SignIn.emailCodeInstead: Email me a sign-in code instead
SignIn.reasonSessionEnded: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
SignIn.reasonReauth: For your security, please sign in again to continue.
SignIn.reasonPasswordChanged: Your password has been changed. Please sign in with your new password.

SignInCode.title: Sign in with a code
SignInCode.description: We will email you a 6-digit code. No password needed.
SignInCode.codeSent: If this address can be used with Spiriteal, a code is on its way. It expires in 10 minutes.
SignInCode.usePassword: Sign in with a password instead

SignUp.title: Create your account
SignUp.description: Next, you will confirm you are 18 or older and review our terms.
SignUp.checkInbox: Check your inbox. If this address can be used, we have sent a link to confirm it. The link expires in 10 minutes.

ForgotPassword.title: Reset your password
ForgotPassword.description: Enter your email and we will send you a link to choose a new password.
ForgotPassword.sent: If an account uses this address, a reset link is on its way. It expires in 10 minutes.

ResetPassword.title: Choose a new password
ResetPassword.description: You will stay signed in on this device. Other devices will be signed out.
ResetPassword.mfaFirst: Complete two-step verification first, then choose your new password.

Mfa.title: Two-step verification
Mfa.requiredNotice: Your role requires two-step verification with an authenticator app.
Mfa.challengeDescription: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
Mfa.enrollDescription: Add an authenticator app (such as Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator) for an extra layer of security.
Mfa.scanQr: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
Mfa.qrAlt: QR code for setting up your authenticator app
Mfa.manualEntry: Can’t scan? Enter this key in your app instead:
Mfa.backupAdvice: Tip: add Spiriteal to a second authenticator app too, so you can still sign in if you lose your phone.

Onboarding.title: Before you begin
Onboarding.description: Please confirm the following. You can read each document in full before agreeing.
Onboarding.adultAttestation: I confirm that I am 18 years of age or older.
Onboarding.acceptTerms: I agree to the <terms>Terms of Service</terms>.
Onboarding.acceptPrivacy: I have read the <privacy>Privacy Notice</privacy> and understand how my personal data is used.

Account.title: Your account
Account.securityDescription: Password, email address, two-step verification and sessions.
Account.adminDescription: Grant or remove the practitioner role.
Account.comingSoon: Your wellbeing tools will appear here.

Security.title: Security
Security.reauthTitle: Sign in again to make changes
Security.reauthDescription: For your security, changing your password, email or two-step verification needs a sign-in within the last 5 minutes.
Security.passwordChanged: Your password has been changed and your other devices have been signed out.
Security.emailDescription: We will send confirmation links to both your current and your new address. The change happens once both are confirmed.
Security.emailRequested: Check both inboxes to confirm the change.
Security.emailConfirmed: Address confirmed. Once both your current and new addresses are confirmed, your email is updated.
Security.mfaNone: No authenticator app is set up.
Security.mfaRemoveConfirm: Remove this authenticator app? You will no longer be able to use it to sign in.
Security.mfaRemoved: The authenticator app has been removed.
Security.sessionsDescription: Signs you out on every device, including this one.

Admin.title: Practitioner access
Admin.description: Look up a member by email to grant or remove the practitioner role. Every lookup and change is recorded.
Admin.notFound: No account uses that email address.
Admin.granted: The practitioner role has been granted. They will be asked to set up two-step verification.
Admin.revoked: The practitioner role has been removed.
